*INTRODUCTION*
"Explain your research question (and necessary background information) as well as the value of answering it."

*METHODS*
"Explain how the data were obtained, as well as providing a citation of their source (if available). Provide a summary of the data by reporting summary statistics and appropriate figures. Identify the observational unit, select a data model (likelihood) and justify this choice (i.e., determine if assumptions are reasonable and if not, provide some possible consequences). Explain what the relevant parameters of the likelihood are and how they will be useful in answering your question. Choose and justify your prior distributions."

Likelihood: Since the data is binary (Goal vs. Miss), the appropriate likelihood function is the Binomial Distribution. We assume the data is independent and identically distributed (Bernoulli trials) for each foot.

Prior: We will use a Beta(1, 1) prior. This is a "Uniform" or "Uninformative" prior, meaning that before seeing the data, we assume any success rate between 0% and 100% is equally likely. This is a safe "objective" starting point.



```{r}
library(tidyverse)

#Load the data
shootouts <- vroom('WorldCupShootouts.csv')

clean_data <- shootouts %>%
  filter(Foot %in% c("L", "R"), !is.na(Goal)) %>%
  mutate(Foot = factor(Foot, levels = c("L", "R"), labels = c("Left", "Right")))

#Prior Params
# Prior: Beta(1, 1)
prior_alpha <- 1
prior_beta <- 1

# Get counts
counts <- clean_data %>%
  group_by(Foot) %>%
  summarise(
    successes = sum(Goal),
    n = n()
  )

y_L <- counts$successes[counts$Foot == "Left"]
n_L <- counts$n[counts$Foot == "Left"]
y_R <- counts$successes[counts$Foot == "Right"]
n_R <- counts$n[counts$Foot == "Right"]

#Posterior Params
alpha_L <- prior_alpha + y_L
beta_L  <- prior_beta + (n_L - y_L)

alpha_R <- prior_alpha + y_R
beta_R  <- prior_beta + (n_R - y_R)

# Mean = alpha / (alpha + beta)
# Var  = (alpha * beta) / ( (alpha + beta)^2 * (alpha + beta + 1) )

mu_L <- alpha_L / (alpha_L + beta_L)
var_L <- (alpha_L * beta_L) / ((alpha_L + beta_L)^2 * (alpha_L + beta_L + 1))

mu_R <- alpha_R / (alpha_R + beta_R)
var_R <- (alpha_R * beta_R) / ((alpha_R + beta_R)^2 * (alpha_R + beta_R + 1))

# Diff ~ Normal(mean_diff, sd_diff)
mean_diff <- mu_L - mu_R
var_diff  <- var_L + var_R
sd_diff   <- sqrt(var_diff)

# Calculate 95% Credible Interval
ci_lower <- qnorm(0.025, mean = mean_diff, sd = sd_diff)
ci_upper <- qnorm(0.975, mean = mean_diff, sd = sd_diff)

# Calculate Probability Left > Right
prob_L_better <- 1 - pnorm(0, mean = mean_diff, sd = sd_diff)

#VISUALIZATION
x_vals <- seq(mean_diff - 4*sd_diff, mean_diff + 4*sd_diff, length.out = 1000)
y_vals <- dnorm(x_vals, mean = mean_diff, sd = sd_diff)
plot_df <- data.frame(Difference = x_vals, Density = y_vals)

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Difference, y = Density)) +
  geom_line(color = "lightblue", size = 1.2) +
  geom_area(fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.3) +
  # Add CI
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(ci_lower, ci_upper), linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = ci_upper + 0.02, y = max(y_vals)/2, label = "95% CI", angle = 90) +
  # Add referance line at zero
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "red", size = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior Difference of Left vs Right Success",
    subtitle = paste("95% CI:", round(ci_lower, 3), "to", round(ci_upper, 3)),
    x = "Difference in Proportion (Left - Right)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
